Packaging: ASLCP_TAKEOVER option and port 80 in install.sh (#24)

ASLCP_TAKEOVER=1 turns off the other ASL web services (Allmon3, the web
server of the ASL web UIs, asl-web-ui, Supermon; only units that exist and
are enabled or running), records them in /var/lib/aslcp/takeover.list and
moves ASLCP to port 80. ASLCP_TAKEOVER=undo restores them. ASLCP_PORT=80 is
accepted through the port80.conf drop-in; the switch is refused, naming the
program, while another program holds port 80. Documented in the README, the
install page and the installer header; tests added for option parsing, unit
selection, state file, port 80 and undo.
